newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CAR SALES RISE SIX PCT IN FIRST NINE MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CAR SALES RISE SIX PCT IN FIRST NINE MONTHS.

text.p: Sales of new cars in the Netherlands rose by six percent to 394,200 in the first nine months of 1996, Dutch automotive body (RAI) said on Tuesday.
It said sales of vans in the period surged by 31 percent to 53,700 and truck sales were up 23 percent to 12,800.
RAI repeated its forecast that full-year car sales would total 450,000-460,000, compared with 446,388 in 1995.
General Motors remained at the top of the car sales league, its sales up 2.4 percent to 55,237.
Volkswagen/Audi , in second place, sold 54,133 cars in the first nine months, up 12.8 percent from 1995.
